findings.title: The published suite 3 corpus has no machine-readable record for the current stated-24-words outcome
findings.releaseBlockingReason: The specification's own conformance requirement was not met by the corpus it ships; fixed by importing the record from implementation revision 3a705db6945b35f8c248c44893e71ddc36902af4.
evidence: Baseline text at 2cd5e4c96a2bf2cc177f8b99b81fa7427bdf1b86 plus the uncommitted tree; reviewer notes are local only.
findings.reproduction: Read the affected passages of the baseline tree side by side.
findings.expected: Each conformance case states its expected readings, word counts, order and labels in the corpus itself, as the Test Vectors section requires.
findings.observed: The `selected-24-words` record keeps only the 24-word reading requested under the historical rules; the current two-reading result exists only as a prose table in the corpus notes.
findings.impact: A conforming implementation cannot be checked mechanically against the current length rules.
findings.recommendedFix: Import the reference implementation's `stated-24-words` record with its manifest and independent verification record from a pinned commit, update the counts and provenance, and shorten the prose table to a pointer.
findings.requiredVerification: SHA256SUMS of the imported corpus, the record hash, the case counts in all notes, and a replay of the new case.

findings.title: Two length rules applied to one input with different results
findings.releaseBlockingReason: A bounded wording or consistency defect; no suite algorithm, packing or vector is affected.
affected: README.md (Recovering a mnemonic, step 3 and the list after it)
evidence: Baseline text at 2cd5e4c96a2bf2cc177f8b99b81fa7427bdf1b86 plus the uncommitted tree; reviewer notes are local only.
findings.reproduction: Read the affected passages of the baseline tree side by side.
findings.expected: Every combination of stated length and match count falls under exactly one rule.
findings.observed: With 24 words stated and exactly one short match, 'one other length matches: use the detected length' withheld the 24-word reading, while '24 words stated, but a short length matches' offered it.
findings.impact: Implementations could disagree on the one case that creation step 2 exists for.
findings.recommendedFix: Write the rules as two lists, with and without a stated length, and narrow the conflicting rule to a stated short length.
findings.requiredVerification: Trace every combination of stated length (none, short, 24) and match count (0, 1, 2 or more).

findings.title: The private-screen confirmation could not satisfy the replacement rule
findings.releaseBlockingReason: A bounded wording or consistency defect; no suite algorithm, packing or vector is affected.
evidence: Baseline text at 2cd5e4c96a2bf2cc177f8b99b81fa7427bdf1b86 plus the uncommitted tree; reviewer notes are local only.
findings.reproduction: Read the affected passages of the baseline tree side by side.
findings.expected: Each confirmation path the specification allows leads to a replacement that can be rehearsed.
findings.observed: Showing the phrase was a MAY after a MUST it did not name as an alternative, and a replacement without a source verifier then needed an independent reference the owner did not have.
findings.impact: Applications following the text strictly could refuse the re-encryption the owner's path was meant to allow.
findings.recommendedFix: State the two confirmation paths as alternatives; require the rehearsal reference before the replacement is created; allow it to be derived from the phrase after the owner's explicit confirmation, for the replacement rehearsal only.
findings.requiredVerification: Trace short source with verifier, 24-word reading and suite 4 reading through the rule.

findings.title: The rehearsal check had no outcome for a reading that is not verified
findings.releaseBlockingReason: A bounded wording or consistency defect; no suite algorithm, packing or vector is affected.
evidence: Baseline text at 2cd5e4c96a2bf2cc177f8b99b81fa7427bdf1b86 plus the uncommitted tree; reviewer notes are local only.
findings.reproduction: Read the affected passages of the baseline tree side by side.
findings.expected: An unverified reading is never reported as a match.
findings.observed: With no length stated, a wrong password on a short source gives an unverified 24-word reading; the check defined only 'matches' and 'does not match'.
findings.impact: An application could report 'matches' before the owner discards a backup.
findings.recommendedFix: Report 'not verified' when only unverified readings result and no reference was supplied; ask for the length of a short source.
findings.requiredVerification: Apply the rules to the wrong-password-detect case.

findings.title: The recovery plan advised recording the source length next to the backup
findings.releaseBlockingReason: A bounded wording or consistency defect; no suite algorithm, packing or vector is affected.
evidence: Baseline text at 2cd5e4c96a2bf2cc177f8b99b81fa7427bdf1b86 plus the uncommitted tree; reviewer notes are local only.
findings.reproduction: Read the affected passages of the baseline tree side by side.
findings.expected: Recovery needs only the container and the password by default, and a note showing a short source is kept apart from the container.
findings.observed: The supplement told the owner to record the source length in every case; the specification asked for the word count in the rare case without saying where to keep it.
findings.impact: A found note showing fewer than 24 words removes the decoy option that the deniability analysis relies on.
findings.recommendedFix: Record only what recovery needs, the word count only in the rare case, and keep that note apart from the container like the password.
findings.requiredVerification: Read both passages against the deniability limits.

findings.title: The re-encryption risk figure named the wrong cause and left one accepted risk unstated
findings.releaseBlockingReason: A bounded wording or consistency defect; no suite algorithm, packing or vector is affected.
evidence: Baseline text at 2cd5e4c96a2bf2cc177f8b99b81fa7427bdf1b86 plus the uncommitted tree; reviewer notes are local only.
findings.reproduction: Read the affected passages of the baseline tree side by side.
findings.expected: The figure names its source and the accepted case states its risk.
findings.observed: The `2^-32` figure was attributed to any short verifier, although it comes from the 32-bit verifier of the 21-word layout, and a stated 21 that matches was accepted on that verifier without saying so.
findings.impact: Readers could treat a stated 21-word match as stronger than it is.
findings.recommendedFix: Attribute the figure to the 21-word layout and wrong passwords, and state the accepted risk.

findings.title: The text still presents itself as release 0.5.0
findings.releaseBlockingReason: A release must carry its own version; set to 0.6.0 in the release commit.
affected: README.md (badge, banner, preamble, release line, previous releases)
evidence: Baseline text at 2cd5e4c96a2bf2cc177f8b99b81fa7427bdf1b86 plus the uncommitted tree; reviewer notes are local only.
findings.reproduction: Read the affected passages of the baseline tree side by side.
findings.expected: The released text names its own version; an implementation conforming to 0.5.0 is not assumed to conform to the new text.
findings.observed: Badge, banner, preamble version and citation metadata say 0.5.0 and 'Released as v0.5.0', while the text holds normative changes that change conformance; the previous-releases list lacks v0.5.0.
findings.impact: Readers and implementers would take the changed rules for the released 0.5.0 rules.
findings.recommendedFix: At release, set version 0.6.0 (a minor version: conformance changed, suites did not), date the CHANGELOG section, add v0.5.0 to the previous releases and rewrite the banner sentence.
findings.requiredVerification: Read the version strings and run the document checks after the change.

findings.releaseBlockingReason: A bounded wording or consistency defect; no suite algorithm, packing or vector is affected.

evidence: Baseline text at 2cd5e4c96a2bf2cc177f8b99b81fa7427bdf1b86 plus the uncommitted tree; reviewer notes are local only.

observations.releaseBlockingReason: A bounded wording or consistency defect; no suite algorithm, packing or vector is affected.
evidence: Baseline text at 2cd5e4c96a2bf2cc177f8b99b81fa7427bdf1b86 plus the uncommitted tree; reviewer notes are local only.
observations.reproduction: Read the affected passages of the baseline tree side by side.
observations.expected: The warning names wallets that other passwords open on the old container.
observations.observed: The implementation speaks of 'funds at the old addresses' and advises destroying the old container without a condition about wallets that other passwords open.
observations.impact: Owners could destroy a container that a derived wallet still needs.
observations.recommendedFix: Handed to the implementation; no specification change.
observations.requiredVerification: Check the implementation's warning text before its release.

observations.title: Untracked repository files
observations.releaseBlockingReason: A bounded wording or consistency defect; no suite algorithm, packing or vector is affected.
evidence: Baseline text at 2cd5e4c96a2bf2cc177f8b99b81fa7427bdf1b86 plus the uncommitted tree; reviewer notes are local only.
observations.reproduction: Read the affected passages of the baseline tree side by side.
observations.expected: Repository files are either committed or excluded.
observations.observed: Both are untracked and not excluded; AGENTS.md claims that every vector is reproducible by the current implementation, which is not true for the archived suite 2 vectors.
observations.impact: A careless add could commit them.
observations.recommendedFix: Owner decision: commit AGENTS.md with the claim corrected, or exclude it; exclude docs/drafts/.

recommendations.title: Release as 0.6.0 after the corpus import
recommendations.detail: Import the stated-24-words record (FUN001), then set version 0.6.0 (BLD001) and name the implementation release (DOC016).

limitations: No full-size Argon2id was run; transcripts were recomputed from their recorded Argon2id outputs.
The reviewers belong to one model family; this is not an independent cryptographic review.
The run logs of the baseline were overwritten by the rerun after remediation; the baseline result (all checks passed except the link-check false positive) is recorded here.

The verifier confirmed every fix and reported six follow-up wording gaps in the new text (three outcomes of the rehearsal check, suite 3 scope of its length question, the derived rehearsal reference, two unlinked references, the suite in the recovery plan, and four CHANGELOG gaps). They were corrected afterwards and checked by the coordinator only.

remediationAddendum.authorization: Owner's instruction of 2026-10-09 to fix all findings.

assessment: No formula, bound, vector or proof step is wrong. The baseline had four functional, three security, one build and eighteen documentation findings, all in the application rules and their wording. Release blockers remaining: none.
